items.title: Replace misleading version-bump skip wording
items.context: DONE currently prints version bump skipped (no material code change). For experiment harness changes this is false; the real condition is no watched CLI/runtime inputs changed. Update the source constant and all dependent expectations.

happy.desc: DONE version-bump skip output for a non-runtime change says the skip happened because no watched CLI/runtime inputs changed, and the user-facing line no longer says no material code change; WHY: the wording matches the real runtime-scope condition.

edge.desc: All dependent expectations for the skip reason are updated consistently to the watched CLI/runtime inputs wording; WHY: no smoke snapshot or assertion preserves the old misleading phrase.

adversarial.desc: A focused negative check fails if the user-facing DONE/version-bump skip reason still contains no material code change anywhere in the exercised output path; WHY: a partial rename cannot leave the misleading phrase visible.

items.title: Prove DONE skip output distinguishes runtime scope from material code
items.context: Update focused smoke coverage so a non-runtime/material-code merge can skip CLI version bump with an accurate runtime-input explanation, while runtime-input changes still require build/bump behavior.

items.title: Document the CLI-version boundary
items.context: Clarify that the CLI patch version tracks Proofbound CLI/runtime inputs, not every repository code artifact such as offline experiment harnesses; avoid changing product policy unless a later story introduces a separate experiment/product ledger.
